analysis.title: EQ Technical Analysis - Expect near-term rebound in Alphabet
key_insights: Nvidia: short-term technical outlook bullish. Spot ref 216.00 (close 10/26), down from 217.09 at the 10/20 review. Price closed back within the Cloud and diverged from the lower Bollinger with downward momentum easing. Targets 242.12 (reached but not broken) then 249.13. Expects the 10/12 gap-down to fill, an advance to 229.11. A bearish view requires a close below 189.66 (targets 171.03, 164.27).

Meta Platforms: short-term outlook bullish, expects a rebound. Spot ref 630.56, down from 705.44 since 10/20. The 9/9 gap-up is partially filled. Meta closed below the Cloud and sat below the lower Bollinger for three sessions. Targets 796.25 then 870.93, expects downside to hold in the Cloud region (605.50-628.03). Bearish only on a close below 524.49 (target 479.80).

Alphabet: short-term outlook neutral with a near-term rebound expected. Spot ref 316.80, down from 344.18 since 10/20. Price sat below the lower Bollinger for three sessions while downward momentum increased. Upside expected to fail again at the Cloud (resistance 349.74). Bullish on a close above 384.48 (targets 408.61, 422.47). Bearish on a close below 314.90 (target 272.11).

Oracle: short-term outlook bearish. Spot ref 126.06, down from 129.59. Closing below the Cloud exposes 114.50 then 99.87. Rebounds viewed as corrective, with rejection expected in the Cloud region (142.57-146.82). A close above the Cloud turns it bullish (targets 170.70, 197.79).

Alibaba: short-term outlook bearish with a near-term rebound expected. Spot ref 97.60, down from 104.60. Gapped lower 10/22 and sat below the lower Bollinger for three sessions to 10/26. Expects a fill of the 10/20 and 10/22 gap-downs to 108.30, then a resume lower to 88.65 and 77.35. A close above the Cloud (114.08) turns it bullish (targets 130.30, 154.20). UBS reiterates skepticism on upside after multiple failures since mid-September.

CME Group: short-term outlook bullish. Spot ref 308.06. A head and shoulders bottom has a textbook target of 321.69. Price is converging toward the upper Bollinger with rising upward momentum. Declines are viewed as corrective, with support expected at 289.90.
